title: If You Know These 5 Words, Your English Is Advanced (Part 2) #shorts
description:
If you know these 5 words, your English is advanced:
• Candid: honest and direct
• Diligent: hard-working and careful
• Frugal: careful with money
• Tedious: long and boring
• Vivid: very bright and clear

How many did you know? Write your score in the comments.
